secrets_hardcoded_in_config_or_iac.title: Secrets Hardcoded in Config or IaC
secrets_hardcoded_in_config_or_iac.description: Plaintext secrets present in tracked source/config/IaC (incl. git history); fires is_true.

secret_scanning_enabled.title: Secret Scanning Enabled
secret_scanning_enabled.description: Pre-commit and/or CI secret-scanning guard enforced before secrets land in VCS; fires is_false.

secrets_in_env_or_image_layers.title: Secrets in Env Vars or Image Layers
secrets_in_env_or_image_layers.description: Secret values in .env/plaintext env vars/docker ENV-ARG/build-args/baked image layers; fires is_true.

secrets_injected_at_runtime_not_baked_in.title: Secrets Injected at Runtime (Not Baked In)
secrets_injected_at_runtime_not_baked_in.description: Secrets injected at runtime by the orchestrator (sidecar/in-memory mount/secretKeyRef), absent from the artifact; fires is_false.

secrets_stored_in_dedicated_secret_manag.title: Secrets Stored in Dedicated Secret Manager
secrets_stored_in_dedicated_secret_manag.description: Secrets live in a centralized managed vault/secret manager referenced at runtime, not flat config or inline literals; fires is_false. (Merged secrets_stored_in_vault into this canonical attribute.)

iac_version_controlled_with_required_rev.title: IaC Version-Controlled with Required Review
iac_version_controlled_with_required_rev.description: All IaC/config in VCS with branch protection requiring approving peer-reviewed PR before merge; fires is_false. NIST CM-3/CM-5.

commits_signed.title: Commits Signed
commits_signed.description: Config/IaC changes carry verified provenance via required signed commits + signature-verified artifacts; fires is_false. NIST CM-14.

config_change_detection_enabled.title: Config Change Detection Enabled
config_change_detection_enabled.description: Running config continuously compared to baseline; out-of-band modification/drift detected+alerted; fires is_false. NIST CM-6.

least_privilege_access_enforced.title: Least-Privilege Access Enforced
least_privilege_access_enforced.description: Read/management access to secret+config stores restricted to need-to-know least-privilege, not wildcard; fires is_false. NIST CM-5.

per_secret_access_scoping.title: Per-Secret Access Scoping
per_secret_access_scoping.description: Policies scope to individual secrets/paths rather than an entire store/prefix; fires is_false (blanket/wildcard).

secret_access_audited.title: Secret Access Audited
secret_access_audited.description: Access to secrets + config changes recorded in an audit trail (who/what/when); fires is_false.

encrypted_at_rest.title: Encrypted at Rest
encrypted_at_rest.description: Secrets+sensitive config encrypted at rest with strong managed-key crypto (AES-256, KMS/HSM separate from data); fires is_false.

tls_only_transport.title: TLS-Only Transport
tls_only_transport.description: All secret/config retrieval only over TLS, never plaintext HTTP; fires is_false.

iac_state_secrets_encrypted.title: IaC State Secrets Encrypted
iac_state_secrets_encrypted.description: IaC state (can hold plaintext secrets) in an encrypted access-controlled remote backend, not in VCS; fires is_false.

hardened_baseline_documented.title: Hardened Baseline Documented
hardened_baseline_documented.description: Approved version-controlled hardened baseline (most-restrictive mode) exists to compare against and ship from; fires is_false. NIST CM-2/CM-6. (Merged documented_baseline_exists into this canonical attribute.)

default_accounts_removed_or_changed.title: Default Accounts Removed or Changed
default_accounts_removed_or_changed.description: Vendor/default accounts + default passwords removed or rotated before prod; fires is_false. OWASP A05; CIS 4.

unnecessary_services_disabled.title: Unnecessary Services Disabled
unnecessary_services_disabled.description: Least-functionality: only essential ports/protocols/services/software enabled; fires is_false. NIST CM-7; CIS 4.

debug_and_verbose_errors_disabled_in_pro.title: Debug and Verbose Errors Disabled in Prod
debug_and_verbose_errors_disabled_in_pro.description: Debug endpoints + verbose/stack-trace errors disabled in prod; fires is_false. OWASP A05.

sample_apps_and_default_content_removed.title: Sample Apps and Default Content Removed
sample_apps_and_default_content_removed.description: Sample apps/demo content/default install artifacts removed from prod; fires is_false. OWASP A05.

drift_detection_enabled.title: Drift Detection Enabled
drift_detection_enabled.description: Running config continuously compared to baseline with drift detection + alerting; fires is_false. NIST CM-6.

running_config_matches_baseline.title: Running Config Matches Baseline
running_config_matches_baseline.description: Live config agrees with the reviewed baseline (no silent divergence); fires is_false.

out_of_band_changes_controlled.title: Out-of-Band Changes Controlled
out_of_band_changes_controlled.description: Changes forced through VCS-reviewed change management, not manual hotfixes; fires is_false.

config_repo_private.title: Config Repo Private
config_repo_private.description: VCS repo holding config/IaC is private (not publicly clonable); fires is_false.

config_files_not_world_readable.title: Config Files Not World-Readable
config_files_not_world_readable.description: Config/secret files not world-readable and not web-served; fires is_false.

config_object_storage_not_publicly_acces.title: Config Object Storage Not Publicly Accessible
config_object_storage_not_publicly_acces.description: Object-storage buckets holding config/IaC/secrets not publicly accessible; fires is_false.

metadata_endpoint_access_restricted.title: Metadata Endpoint Access Restricted
metadata_endpoint_access_restricted.description: Cloud instance metadata endpoints access-restricted (IMDSv2 token, hop-limit, not proxied/SSRF-forwarded); fires is_false.

iac_state_not_publicly_exposed.title: IaC State Not Publicly Exposed
iac_state_not_publicly_exposed.description: IaC state not committed to VCS and backend not publicly accessible; fires is_false.

config_backed_up_to_known_good.title: Config Backed Up to Known-Good
config_backed_up_to_known_good.description: Config/IaC recoverable to a reviewed known-good state (retained VCS history + revert path); fires is_false. NIST 800-128.

secret_store_and_state_backed_up.title: Secret Store and State Backed Up
secret_store_and_state_backed_up.description: Secret-store contents + IaC state backed up and restorable independently of VCS; fires is_false.

rollback_tested.title: Rollback Tested
rollback_tested.description: Rollback/restore to known-good exercised and verified (not assumed); fires is_false.
